en.headline: Cheung Kong Center II nearly fully leased after SIG takes three floors
en.dek: CK Hutchison said the 41-storey Central tower’s leasable space is almost fully taken, with US quant firm Susquehanna International Group signing for about 52,000 square feet.
body: CK Hutchison Holdings said on Thursday that Cheung Kong Center II in Central is approaching full occupancy after recent leasing activity that included a major commitment from US quantitative trading firm Susquehanna International Group.

The group confirmed that SIG has signed leases for three floors totalling nearly 52,000 square feet. A company spokesman said leasing at the tower has been very active, drawing top-tier international financial institutions, multinational corporations, mainland and overseas firms, and family offices.

Cheung Kong Center II is the redevelopment of the former Hutchison House. The 41-storey building offers about 560,000 square feet of leasable gross floor area, with typical full-floor plates of roughly 17,254 square feet and harbour views from every unit.

The development sits in the core of the Central business district fronting Victoria Harbour. The near-full letting comes amid continued demand for Grade A office space from financial and trading firms expanding in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 長江集團中心二期可租樓面接近全租 SIG租用三層
zh.dek: 長實表示中環長江集團中心二期可出租樓面已接近全部租出，美國量化交易公司Susquehanna International Group簽約租用約5.2萬平方呎。
body: 長實集團周四表示，中環長江集團中心二期近期租務活躍，可出租樓面已接近全部租出，其中包括美國量化交易公司Susquehanna International Group（SIG）的重大租約。
集團確認SIG已簽約租用三層寫字樓，面積合共接近5.2萬平方呎。發言人指，大廈最近獲多家國際頂級金融機構、跨國企業、國內外知名公司及家族辦公室承租。
長江集團中心二期為和記大廈重建項目，樓高41層，可出租總建築面積約56萬平方呎，標準全層面積約17,254平方呎，每個單位均可飽覽維港景色。
大廈位處中環核心商貿區，前臨維多利亞港。接近全租反映金融及交易機構繼續在香港擴張對甲級寫字樓的需求。
